role.description: Data and business analyst for the outsourcing and third-party risk management department. Maintains the outsourcing register and the DORA Register of Information, checks data quality, writes business requirements for TPRM processes and tools, supports due diligence and risk assessments, and prepares dashboards and reports for management, risk committees and the regulator.
responsibilities: data analysis and reporting on outsourcing and third-party risk
outsourcing register and DORA Register of Information (ICT third-party providers)
business requirements and process analysis for TPRM processes and tools
support for due diligence, risk and criticality assessments, contract and SLA monitoring, and exit plans
dashboards and reports for management, risk committees and the regulator

stakeholders.role_or_group: Procurement, Legal, Compliance, Information Security, Operational Risk
